rule: retrain is exact when every training and validation source is a selector over a public repo whose episode count equals what the source held when the training run started; otherwise approximate. A critic whose frozen DP encoder is not a released checkpoint is approximate. A source with round_dataset_session reads a session published whole as its own repo instead of that session of the round dataset, because the round dataset leaves out some of the session's episodes.
